description.text: Objective Strengthen Chinese training and help foreign students to study for Bachelor Degree Help foreign students to enhance the understanding of Chinese culture and adapt them to Chinese education modes and society for student without science background who wants to apply MBBS Main Courses The course mainly focus on language skills including listening, speaking, reading and writing and 26 classes a week a guarantee for good learning. The course also has elective courses, 6 classes a week including mathematics, physics, English, economics, biology and chemistry, which are the basic courses in the undergraduate program. Course Arrangement The courses will be given from Monday to Friday, about 24-26 class hours per week. The duration is 15 weeks, and main courses are Chinese and English training, Physics/chemistry and other basic courses. Click here to see the timetable of the courses

duration.text: The Pre-university programs at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.

requirements.text: 1.Under the age of 35, 2.a high school graduate or with equivalent qualification, 3.able to take courses in Chinese (passing the 3th level HSK), or to major in Aeronautical Engineering, International Economics and Trade,Telecomunications Engineering or Mechanical Engineering (taught at SAU in the English medium).
